title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Nila gets angry when Chozhan returns home late. Panicked over missing Nila's bangle gift, Chozhan searches with his boss and unable to find the jewellery, he is devastated.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Lakshmi reminisces with an old friend about movies. Encouraged by Mathi and Malar, Lakshmi asks Ragavan for permission to watch one, but he rejects it.

title: Bigg Boss
episodeTitle: BBTam Day 58: An Academy for Erring Elders
description: Post the debates and disputes, Jason bags the top rank. In the academy task, housemates play naughty elders reforming their bad habits, and Vinoth’s Tamil class sparks laughter.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Aishwarya feels guilty when Sethupathi loses faith in people after Eshwari and Chitra's deception. Later, Karuppu advises him against making hasty decisions in anger.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Karthik is invited to Kasthuri's village as Priya calls for dance practice. Saranya confronts Pooja over Aadhavan's phone in her room while Shyam announces his marriage to Madhu.

title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Vennila borrows money at a high interest rate to help Rajeshwari clear her debt. At the workshop, Kanmani is impressed by Anbu's knowledge of baby care and maternity needs.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Abhi is heartbroken over missing her parents and her leaked wedding. She vows revenge on Indhira and refuses to listen when Indhira tries to clear up the confusion.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Palanivel requests Muthuvel and Sakthivel to join the anniversary celebration. Meanwhile, Gomathi and Pandian are amazed by the grand wedding arrangements made by their family.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Sathya suggests funding Meena's delivery while Chandra plans to care for her. Annamalai becomes the first customer for Meena and Muthu's Gulkand, which Rohini helps sell.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Sandhya is impressed by Vetri's support and confides her love for him to Vethanayagam. Meanwhile, Vetri assists Abinaya with household chores, leading to a close moment.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Manjamalai's family prays to Manthiyan, while Poongodi explains to Pechi how posters could help catch the killer. Later, Poongodi makes fun of Azhagar as he struggles on the farm.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Ilamathi foils Kalamma's plan to make Paraman quit the election. Kalamma then distributes money to buy votes, while Ilamathi's parents support Paraman's election campaign.
